name: Grafana
extraction_note: The maintainers ship the manifest as a YAML code block in the official installation guide. human/grafana.yaml was extracted verbatim from L96-177 of that page, with only the 3-space list indentation removed.

intent_evidence.quote: On this page, you will find instructions for installing and running Grafana on Kubernetes using Kubernetes manifests for the setup. If Helm is your preferred option, refer to [Grafana Helm community charts](https://github.com/grafana/helm-charts).

If you plan to use Kubernetes in a production setting, it's recommended to utilize managed cloud services like [Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)](https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine), [Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)](https://aws.amazon.com/eks/), or [Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/products/kubernetes-service/).
intent_evidence.note: This recommends a managed Kubernetes provider for production clusters; it does not call the manifest a demo or say it is unsuitable for production. The page also offers Helm charts as an alternative (L16).
